attributes.name: Khalib
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, Khalib deals 2 Force damage to a random character at this location; each character at this location must then succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 11 check or be dealt 1d4 Fire damage.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
